name: Amnicon River
blurb: Amnicon River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. This is a long section and may require more than one day; plan daylight, supplies and legal overnight stops. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Lindquist Landing’s position relative to Lyman Dam needs confirmation. This long itinerary also reaches the Amnicon Falls and rapids corridor; a usable exit and carry have not been established. Do not plan it as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Lyman Lake and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

notices.title: Amnicon Falls interrupts this itinerary
notices.text: DNR identifies multiple waterfalls and rapids at Amnicon Falls State Park, within this long river corridor. Reviewing only Lyman Dam near the start would not establish a usable trip. A suitable itinerary, exit and carry around the falls still need review.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — Amnicon Falls State Park
